targets.query:
from(bucket: "hestia")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "hestia" and r._field == "temp")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.area, set: ${area:json}))
  |> last()
  |> group(columns: ["area"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "area"])
